```{r respiration}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)     
library(emmeans) 
library(ggpubr) 
library(Matrix)


resp <- read_excel("C:/Users/jwl0037/Downloads/biochartree.xlsx", sheet="respiration", range="A1:E193")
#head(resp)

resp <- resp %>%
  mutate(respiration = ifelse(replication == 2 & day == 2, NA, respiration))

#------------ 

resp$biochar_ratio <- as.factor(resp$biochar_ratio)
resp$day <- as.factor(resp$day)
resp$fertilizer <- as.factor(resp$fertilizer)

#------------ 


biochar_summary <- resp %>%
  group_by(biochar_ratio) %>%
  summarize(mean_resp = mean(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_resp = sd(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(),
            se_resp = sd_resp / sqrt(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(biochar_ratio,
                       levels = c(0, 25, 50, 100),
                       labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "100%")),
    plot_type = "Biochar Level"
  )

# Summarize by fertilizer
fert_summary <- resp %>%
  group_by(fertilizer) %>%
  summarize(mean_resp = mean(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_resp = sd(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(),
            se_resp = sd_resp / sqrt(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = factor(
      fertilizer,
      levels = c("none", "half", "full", "double"),
      labels = c("none", "1/2-standard", "standard", "2×-standard")
    ),
    plot_type = "Fertilizer Rate"
  )


# significant letters
  # Biochar letters: 0%, 25%, 50%, 100%
  biochar_summary$sig_letter <- c("a", "a", "a", "b")

  # Fertilizer letters: none, half, full, double
  fert_summary$sig_letter <- c("b", "b", "b", "a")
  
# Combine both
combined_summary <- bind_rows(biochar_summary, fert_summary)

# Plot
ggplot(combined_summary, aes(x = treatment, y = mean_resp, fill = plot_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_resp - se_resp, ymax = mean_resp + se_resp),
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_letter, y = mean_resp + se_resp + 0.02),  # 0.02 is offset above error bar
            position = position_dodge(0.9), size = 5) +
  facet_wrap(~ plot_type, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Treatment",
       y = expression("Mean CO"[2]~"flux rates (mmol CO"[2]~"m"^{-2}~"s"^{-1}*")")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Biochar Level" = "#4DAF4A", "Fertilizer Rate" = "#377EB8")) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",  # 🚫 Remove legend entirely
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),  # ✅ Box around each facet
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "black"),  # Optional: box around facet labels
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

#------------

resp %>%
  group_by(fertilizer, biochar_ratio, day) %>%
  summarise(mean_resp = mean(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_resp = sd(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = sum(!is.na(respiration))) %>%
  arrange(fertilizer, biochar_ratio, day)

# ggplot(resp, aes(x = day, y = respiration, color = factor(biochar_ratio))) +
  # geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.1), alpha = 0.7) +
  # geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  # facet_wrap(~fertilizer) +
  # theme_minimal() +
  # labs(title = "Respiration over Time",
       # x = "Day",
       # y = "Respiration Rate",
       # color = "Biochar Ratio (%)")

#--------
 
resp_clean <- resp %>% filter(!is.na(respiration))

# Convert factors
resp_clean <- resp_clean %>%
  mutate(
    fertilizer = factor(fertilizer),
    biochar_ratio = factor(biochar_ratio),
    day = factor(day),
    replication = factor(replication)
  )

model_aov <- aov(respiration ~ fertilizer * biochar_ratio * day, data = resp_clean)
#TukeyHSD(model_aov, which = "fertilizer")

full_anova <- aov(respiration ~ fertilizer * biochar_ratio * day, data = resp)
#summary(full_anova)

#TukeyHSD(full_anova, which ="fertilizer")
#TukeyHSD(full_anova, which ="biochar_ratio")
#TukeyHSD(full_anova, which ="fertilizer:biochar_ratio")
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Summarize respiration by biochar and fertilizer
combined_summary <- resp %>%
  group_by(biochar_ratio, fertilizer) %>%
  summarize(mean_resp = mean(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_resp = sd(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(),
            se_resp = sd_resp / sqrt(n),
            .groups = "drop")

# Convert fertilizer to factor with proper order & labels
combined_summary$fertilizer <- factor(combined_summary$fertilizer,
                                     levels = c("none", "half", "full", "double"),
                                     labels = c("none", "1/2-standard", "standard", "2×-standard"))

# Convert biochar_ratio to factor with labels & colors
combined_summary$biochar_ratio <- factor(combined_summary$biochar_ratio,
                                         levels = c(0, 25, 50, 100),
                                         labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "100%"))

# Plot
a <-ggplot(combined_summary, aes(x = fertilizer, y = mean_resp, fill = biochar_ratio)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_resp - se_resp, ymax = mean_resp + se_resp),
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  labs(x = "Fertilizer Treatment",
       y = expression("Mean CO"[2]~"flux rates (mmol CO"[2]~"m"^{-2}~"s"^{-1}*")"),
       fill = "Biochar") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0%" = "#4DAF4A", 
                               "25%" = "#9B59B6", 
                               "50%" = "#F39C12", 
                               "100%" = "#2C3E50")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))

# ------------

# Summarize respiration by biochar and fertilizer
combined_summary <- resp %>%
  group_by(biochar_ratio, fertilizer) %>%
  summarize(mean_resp = mean(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_resp = sd(respiration, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(),
            se_resp = sd_resp / sqrt(n),
            .groups = "drop")

# Factor for fertilizer with ordered levels and labels
combined_summary$fertilizer <- factor(combined_summary$fertilizer,
                                     levels = c("none", "half", "full", "double"),
                                     labels = c("none", "1/2-standard", "standard", "2×-standard"))

# Factor for biochar_ratio with labels
combined_summary$biochar_ratio <- factor(combined_summary$biochar_ratio,
                                         levels = c(0, 25, 50, 100),
                                         labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "100%"))

# Create combined factor for x axis (biochar + fertilizer)
combined_summary <- combined_summary %>%
  mutate(biochar_fert = interaction(biochar_ratio, fertilizer, sep = "_"))

# Define levels for biochar_fert to keep correct order
combined_summary$biochar_fert <- factor(combined_summary$biochar_fert,
                                        levels = c(
                                          "0%_none", "0%_1/2-standard", "0%_standard", "0%_2×-standard",
                                          "25%_none", "25%_1/2-standard", "25%_standard", "25%_2×-standard",
                                          "50%_none", "50%_1/2-standard", "50%_standard", "50%_2×-standard",
                                          "100%_none", "100%_1/2-standard", "100%_standard", "100%_2×-standard"
                                        ))

# Create x axis labels with fertilizer only, repeated for each biochar group
x_labels <- rep(levels(combined_summary$fertilizer), times = length(levels(combined_summary$biochar_ratio)))

# Plot
ggplot(combined_summary, aes(x = biochar_fert, y = mean_resp, fill = biochar_ratio)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_resp - se_resp, ymax = mean_resp + se_resp),
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
  scale_fill_discrete(
    name = "Biochar Level (%)",               
    labels = c("0", "25", "50", "100")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Fertilizer Rates",
       y = expression("Mean CO"[2]~"flux rates (mmol CO"[2]~"m"^{-2}~"s"^{-1}*")"),
       fill = "Biochar") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA))

```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)     
library(emmeans) 
library(ggpubr) 
library(Matrix)


# Read and recode
rsr <- read_excel("C:/Users/jwl0037/Downloads/biochartree.xlsx", sheet="rsr", range="A1:D49")

rsr <- rsr %>%
  mutate(
    species = recode(species,
                     "ll" = "Longleaf Pine",
                     "lob" = "Loblolly Pine",
                     "sl" = "Slash Pine"),
    fertilizer = factor(fertilizer, 
                        levels = c("none", "half", "full", "double"),
                        labels = c("none", "1/2-standard", "standard", "2×-standard"))
  )

# Optional filter — remove if plotting all species
rsr_sl <- rsr %>%
  filter(species == "Slash Pine")

# Optional summary
rsr_summary <- rsr_sl %>%
  group_by(biochar_ratio, fertilizer) %>%
  summarise(
    se_RSR = sd(mean_RSR, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot with boxed panels
ggplot(rsr, aes(x = factor(biochar_ratio), y = mean_RSR, fill = fertilizer)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
  facet_wrap(~ species) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Biochar Level (%)", 
       y = "Mean Root-to-Shoot Ratio", 
       title = "",
       fill = "Fertilizer Rate") +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "black"),  # grey box behind facet labels
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")                            # bold text in strips
  )

```


```{r survival}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)     
library(emmeans) 
library(ggpubr) 
library(Matrix)

surv_data <- read_excel("C:/Users/jwl0037/Downloads/biochartree.xlsx", sheet="survival", range="A1:F145")


surv_data <- surv_data %>%
  mutate(
    survival = as.numeric(survival),
    survival_rate = survival / seeded
  )

# Summarize survival rate by group
summary_data <- surv_data %>%
  group_by(species, fertilizer, `biochar_%`) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_survival = mean(survival_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_survival = sd(survival_rate, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )

summary_data$fertilizer <- factor(summary_data$fertilizer, levels = c("none", "half", "full", "double"))

# Plot
# ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = fertilizer, y = mean_survival, fill = factor(`biochar_%`))) +
  # geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  # geom_errorbar(
    # aes(ymin = mean_survival - se_survival, ymax = mean_survival + se_survival),
    # width = 0.2,
    # position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  # ) +
  # facet_wrap(~ species) +
  # labs(y = "Mean Survival Rate", x = "Fertilizer Treatment", fill = "Biochar %") +
  # theme_minimal()

# ----------

surv_data$survival <- as.numeric(surv_data$survival)
surv_data$prop_survived <- surv_data$survival / surv_data$seeded

surv_data$fertilizer <- factor(surv_data$fertilizer, levels = c("none", "half", "full", "double"))
surv_data$species <- factor(surv_data$species)
surv_data$biochar_percent <- as.factor(surv_data$`biochar_%`)

anova_surv <- aov(prop_survived ~ fertilizer * biochar_percent * species, data = surv_data)
summary(anova_surv)

#TukeyHSD(anova_surv, which = "species")
#TukeyHSD(anova_surv, which = "fertilizer:biochar_percent")
#TukeyHSD(anova_surv, which = "fertilizer")
#TukeyHSD(anova_surv, which = "biochar_percent")

# ----------

species_biochar_fert_summary <- surv_data %>%
  group_by(species, biochar_percent, fertilizer) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_survival = mean(prop_survived, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_survival = sd(prop_survived, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#species_biochar_fert_summary
#write.csv(species_biochar_fert_summary, "C:/Users/jwl0037/Downloads/survival_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ----------

species_biochar_summary <- surv_data %>%
  group_by(species, biochar_percent) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_survival = mean(prop_survived, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_survival = sd(prop_survived, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#species_biochar_summary

# -----------

fertilizer_summary <- surv_data %>%
  group_by(fertilizer) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_survival = mean(prop_survived, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_survival = sd(prop_survived, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )

#fertilizer_summary
```


```{r Survival Figure}
library(scales)  # for percent_format

summary_data <- surv_data %>%
  mutate(
    species = recode(species,
                     "ll" = "Longleaf Pine",
                     "lob" = "Loblolly Pine",
                     "sl" = "Slash Pine"),
    fertilizer = factor(fertilizer, 
                        levels = c("none", "half", "full", "double"),
                        labels = c("none", "1/2-standard", "standard", "2×-standard"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(species, fertilizer, `biochar_%`) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_survival = mean(survival_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_survival = sd(survival_rate, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

library(scales) 

p <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = fertilizer, y = mean_survival * 100, fill = factor(`biochar_%`))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = (mean_survival - se_survival) * 100, ymax = (mean_survival + se_survival) * 100),
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ species) +
  labs(
    y = "Mean Survival Rate (%)",
    x = "Fertilizer Rate",
    fill = "Biochar Level (%)"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(scale = 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

plot(p)

#ggsave("survival_plot.png", plot = p, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)

# Read your data
germ_data <- read_excel("C:/Users/jlsoc/Downloads/biochartree.xlsx", 
                        sheet = "germination", range = "A1:D13")

# Ensure factors are correct
germ_data <- germ_data %>%
  mutate(
    biochar_level = factor(biochar_level, levels = c("0", "25", "50", "100")),
    species = factor(species)
  )

# Calculate germination rate (%)
germ_data <- germ_data %>%
  mutate(germ_rate = (germinated / sowed) * 100)

# ----- Two-way ANOVA -----
anova_germ <- aov(germ_rate ~ species * biochar_level, data = germ_data)
#summary(anova_germ)

# Tukey post-hoc for species differences
#TukeyHSD(anova_germ, which = "species")

# ----- Get means ± SE by species -----
summary_table <- germ_data %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rate = mean(germ_rate),
    se_rate = sd(germ_rate) / sqrt(n())
  )

print(summary_table)

# Optional: also see by biochar_level if you want to mention no treatment effect
summary_table2 <- germ_data %>%
  group_by(biochar_level) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rate = mean(germ_rate),
    se_rate = sd(germ_rate) / sqrt(n())
  )

print(summary_table2)

```
